positions.title: Staff Software Engineer (Distributed Training, Workflow, Data Lake on K8s)
positions.description:
TL’d two teams on K8s agentic sandboxes + E2E production orchestration stack, except the “sandbox” was basically a data lake and the stack supported agents, ML training/inference, analytics, 40K+ devs, and multi-billion-dollar pipelines.

Built a 1,000-node GPU training cluster + experimentation platform from scratch with the founding R&D team in 2021–2023 — got very AI-pilled, learned a lot about parallelism and fast ML iteration.

Owned multi-cloud provisioning/drift reconciliation for one of Azure’s biggest customers; had fun overwhelming servers and making infra converge anyway.

projects.title: The Reimplementation and Application of Direct Future Prediction to Simple Environments and Offline Learning
projects.description:
Replicated state of the arts results with Keras and AWS clusters in the VizDoom environment via the DQN inspired model DFP (Direct Future Prediction) in Python before applying to Flappy bird simulation and offline environment
Presented to Professor Trevor Darrell and Professor Dawn Song @ UC Berkeley. Received 100/100 as UC Berkeley 294-131 term project

projects.title: Operating System in Pintos
projects.description: Implemented a thread scheduling system, buffer cache, and a file system for Pintos OS in C. Selected few to receive 100% for no detected bugs in OS.
